method: Direct Node assert and full-core VM; no Vitest or worker pools

results.name: Current core exports the four workspace preference operations
Defaults have the exact documented presentation-only shape
Default objects are independent and cannot alter later defaults
Valid custom enums and explicit false values survive normalization
Legacy version-one preferences retain their preset and toolbar state
Unversioned and incorrectly versioned objects return safe defaults
Non-object and array inputs return safe defaults
Preset values are exact enum members rather than inherited names
Text-size values are strictly validated
Panel-surface values are strictly validated
Visibility booleans do not coerce strings, numbers, or null
Unknown lesson and evidence fields are omitted from normalization
Missing and corrupt storage loads defaults without writing repairs
An explicit store is independent of the VM browser store
Partial saves migrate legacy preferences and retain existing choices
Preset-only saves retain text, surface, and visibility customization
Denied storage reads return defaults and denied writes retain previous data
Unavailable browser storage is a controlled load/save fallback
Resetting with fresh defaults restores only the known presentation shape
A patch cannot change the schema version or persist unrelated lesson state
